desc: Ideation: reduce to "max divisor d of A_i with cnt[d] >= K"; sieve cnt in O(M log M); answer via reverse/ascending best-fill sieve, O(1) per query.
Implement the full solution with numpy (bincount, sliced sum for cnt, masked max-fill for best) plus pure-Python fallback; fast I/O via sys.stdin.buffer.read and '\n'.join output.
Verify edge cases: K=1 (answer A_i), K=N (overall gcd), all-equal values, M=1, duplicate values; sanity-check against the three samples mentally or by reasoning.
